title: Stabilize macOS LaunchAgent handoff after automatic updates.
changes: Avoid racing macOS launchd with repeated kickstart -k while a newly bootstrapped RunAtLoad agent is starting; wait for its running state first.
If RunAtLoad fails to start, attempt one non-destructive kickstart, then verify the running job; report the failing helper step without claiming a successful restart.
Preserve owner-scoped service registration, existing installation and pairing, Windows DLL-free source-only interop, and existing native capture consent boundaries.
WebRTC native workers, screen/control E2EE and general remote input are not bundled or enabled by this version.
